python.resolve: marina_rules.contract.resolve(rule, trade_date, scope, market, context, min_verification, as_of=None)
python.coverage: marina_rules.coverage(market, scope, rules, start, end, as_of=None, contract=None)

entrypoints.as_of: optional ISO date on record_at/rule_at/coverage/resolve/limit_price/tick_size: answer only from rules with published_at <= as_of; published later → NOT_YET_PUBLISHED, published_at null → UNKNOWN_PUBLICATION; never falls back to an older record

preflight: coverage() over the whole window before any computation
supply every key in scope.requires per security per day; Marina never infers them
stop on any status other than DETERMINED; cite known_gap_ids when present

context_constraints.grammar: data/<market>/scopes.yaml header: scalar = equality; {eq|in|not_in|min|max} with qualifiers from/to (trade-date window), unless/when (context condition), required; a list = every applicable entry must hold; null value = not supplied

contract_selectors.context_key: contract — the exchange contract code, e.g. au2606; needed where rules[*].contract_keyed_scopes lists the scope (otherwise MISSING_CONTEXT with missing_context ['contract'])
contract_selectors.grammar: record/gap field contracts: {any|none: [clause]}; clause keys (AND): code {in|not_in}, delivery_month {in|not_in}, months_to_delivery {min|max|in} = delivery month index minus trade month index; docs/SCHEMA.md 'Contract selectors'
